Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to execute the core task of extracting specific information from the book's content. Instead of successfully accessing the PDF or the Project MUSE link to read Chapter 2 and find the author, the agent immediately shifted to instructing the user (via the Orchestrator) to "access the link" and "check for relevant information." This created a loop of repetitive instructions ("Please access the link...", "If you are unable to access...") without ever actually retrieving or processing the text. This behavior matches the error pattern of "Repetitive Instructions" and "Lack of Resolution" seen in Example 2, where the agent relies on external user intervention or fails to complete the critical verification task itself, leading to a process blockage.
